specification.objective: Allow abandoning frontend wait on lengthy compaction and prevent late replies from corrupting newer previews.

requirements.statement: Abandonment increments operation request identity and ignores delayed success/failure without claiming backend cancellation.
Show factual request/wait states, clear network/validation errors, manual retry only and no fabricated percentage.
Disallow conflicting controls during actual apply, preserving subsequent feedback.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Abandonment increments operation request identity and ignores delayed success/failure without claiming backend cancellation. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

invariants.statement: Do not change Hermes files, private method bindings, pending approval execution or compaction native application semantics; retain Magi 1.7.8.

forbidden_states.statement: Unapproved, stale or invalid edits are silently applied; LLM is invoked without explicit user opt-in outside compaction.

inputs.statement: Existing Hermes memory entries and Magi Desktop/backend plugin contracts.

outputs.statement: Documented, tested and reversible UX behavior; no direct native memory file writes.

failure_semantics.statement: On invalid source/remote failure preserve memory, preview and user draft; show actionable error.
